metadata.description: Puzzle lock taxonomy for episode designers. Use this to mix and match puzzles with varied rarity, complexity, fun, interaction types, duration, and replay value.

dimensions.rarity: COMMON (seen in many games) / MAGIC (uncommon twist) / RARE (unusual mechanic) / LEGENDARY (unique to re:Solve)
dimensions.fun: 1 (basic click/type) to 5 (rich interactive mini-game with tension)
dimensions.interaction: tap | drag | type | timing | observe (primary interaction mode)
dimensions.replay: static (same answer) | shuffled (randomized order) | procedural (different each play)

metadata.design_guidance: When building an episode, aim for variety: mix at least 3 interaction types, include 1+ RARE/LEGENDARY puzzle, vary complexity (start low, peak mid-episode, end medium-high), and ensure at least one 'fun:4+' puzzle per 3 rooms. Avoid consecutive puzzles with the same interaction type.

4digits-lock.description: Rolling drum PIN pad — drag each digit column vertically to set a 4-digit code
4digits-lock.best_for: Numeric codes derived from clues; combination-style openers

alarm-lock.description: CloudWatch alarm builder — pick metric, threshold, period, action from dropdowns with animated metric graph
alarm-lock.best_for: AWS monitoring theming; teaching alarm configuration

arch-lock.description: Drag service icons onto positioned drop zones over an architecture diagram
arch-lock.best_for: System design, N-tier architectures, service placement

auction-lock.description: Sequential bidding with budget and haggling — key vs decoy lots, seller mood escalates, walk-away risk
auction-lock.best_for: Resource allocation stakes, negotiation themes, economic decision puzzles

az-lock.description: Drag resource cards into availability zone columns for HA distribution

base64-decoder.description: Pure utility tool — Base64 input/output with live decode and copy button; no submit logic
base64-decoder.best_for: Pair with another lock as a helper; forensic/CTF flavour

bazaar-lock.description: Marketplace with gold economy — drag quest scrolls to merchant stalls; each stall yields different reward tier (gold/silver/bronze) and cost
bazaar-lock.best_for: Model-selection theming, economic tradeoffs, choose-your-tool decisions

binary-lock.description: 8-toggle binary switch panel; live decimal readout; correct binary pattern unlocks

blueprint-lock.description: Components arrive one-at-a-time; tap the correct architectural floor to place. Wrong = floor cracks with explanation. Building rises visually as tiers fill

booking-run-lock.description: Live-narrated NPC tool-call debugging — watch an NPC attempt tool calls, spot the broken parameter, pick the right value to fix each call
booking-run-lock.best_for: Agentic AI / tool-use themes, debugging as narrative

bread-break-lock.description: Tap-and-hold each item in a timing sweet-spot window — too short = not broken, too long = crumbles. Multiplying counter across items

cafe-order-lock.description: Persistent live order queue — orders arrive on a timer, sentiment drops if you're slow; assemble drinks (cup + ingredients) to serve. State survives session reload
cafe-order-lock.best_for: Background pressure puzzle running alongside a room, live-service theming

cascade-lock.description: Sequential story steps with multiple-choice questions; cups/lamps light up cumulatively as each step is answered correctly; cinematic reveal at end
cascade-lock.best_for: Narrative reveals, chained realizations, thematic climaxes

chain-lock.description: Drag Lambda pipeline items (event source → function → destination) into correct sequence

cidr-lock.description: Given a VPC CIDR, choose correct subnet CIDR from dropdowns; visual usage bar

color-lock.description: Three RGB sliders blend a live preview; match target color within tolerance

context-lock.description: Golem starts overloaded with all docs producing corrupted live output; player removes poisoned/redundant docs until the stream stabilizes and budget fits
context-lock.best_for: RAG/LLM context-window teaching, information triage themes

cost-lock.description: Adjust dropdowns and sliders to hit a target monthly cost within tolerance; custom cost function
cost-lock.best_for: Cloud cost / FinOps education, optimization stakes

craft-lock.description: Combine materials pairwise using tag-based rules (not fixed recipes) to discover intermediate outputs and reach the goal item

crowd-counter-lock.description: Bird's-eye grid with people clusters at variable counts; tap clusters to add/remove from running tally; hit exact target

crowd-seating-lock.description: Tap cells on a hillside grid to place group markers; groups must not be adjacent (paths between); place exactly N groups

decay-lock.description: Text fragments visibly corrupt/decay on a timer with per-fragment countdowns; player must read and remember, then type answer from memory
decay-lock.best_for: Memory pressure, fading-clue tension, ephemeral-intel themes

deck-battle-lock.description: STS-inspired card battle — play 2 of 4 drawn cards per turn (Persuasion/Composure), react to merchant's cyclic intents, fill conviction meter before gold (HP) depletes
deck-battle-lock.best_for: Boss encounters, negotiation-as-combat, high-stakes climax rooms

deduction-grid-lock.description: Classic Clue-style logic grid — cross-reference clues, cycle each cell YES/NO/blank until deduction is complete

defuse-lock.description: Countdown timer + composite tasks (toggles + code entries) that all must be correct before the timer expires; onTimeout consequence hook
defuse-lock.best_for: Climactic timed rooms, real-tension defusal beats

dial-lock.description: Physical-safe metaphor — vertical dial columns with up/down arrows and swipe support, turn handle to test

dns-lock.description: Chain of dropdowns modeling DNS resolution: domain → zone → record type → target

equipment-rack-lock.description: Balatro-style blind build — arrange, enable/disable, and reorder gear slots without seeing numbers; upgraded gear unlocks from prior quests; deploy on cooldown to see tier result
equipment-rack-lock.best_for: Late-episode capstone, evaluation/tuning themes, roguelike deck-shaping metaphors

evidence-board-lock.description: For each investigation step pick the matching finding from a shuffled dropdown; all rows must match to confirm

evidence-lock.description: Sequential story-narration prompts asking for a numeric answer derived from clues; per-step hints unlock after failed attempts

fog-map-lock.description: Grid covered in fog; spend limited energy to reveal adjacent tiles; collect intel, avoid traps, use bonuses, reach exit with enough intel

grid-org-lock.description: Distribute a pool of people into group zones using +/− buttons; each zone must exactly hit its target

grinder-lock.description: Espresso simulator — three sliders (grind/dose/yield) with per-shot random variance produce a shot time that must land in the target window
grinder-lock.best_for: Calibration/tuning themes with realistic noise; barista fantasy

image-prompt-lock.description: Iterative image commission — pick attributes (color/material/style), submit, get NPC feedback pointing to wrong attribute, refine within max attempts
image-prompt-lock.best_for: Generative-AI prompting themes, iterative refinement teaching

jar-fill-lock.description: Two modes: 'logic' pours water between jars to reach exact target levels (die-hard style); 'timing' holds to fill and releases at a brim line — overshoot spills

jigsaw-lock.description: Sliding-puzzle-style tap-two-to-swap grid; arrange tiles into correct order; optional green feedback on correctly placed tiles

key-lock.description: Two-phase: 1) order key fragments correctly, 2) use assembled key to decrypt an encrypted message

keypad-lock.description: Classic 0–9 PIN pad with enter/clear; wrong-attempt flavour output support

lifecycle-lock.description: Timeline sliders for S3 lifecycle transition day thresholds; each stage must hit its answer day

log-lock.description: Scrollable log output; player selects the lines that match a prompt (e.g., the error line)

match-lock.description: Memory-match flip cards — pair term with definition/icon; misses flip back after a beat; optional face-up variant

maze-lock.description: First-person 3-button maze — Turn Left / Forward / Turn Right; canvas-drawn walls; optional hidden walls/goal, bump penalties, and step budget

milk-jug-lock.description: Multi-step evidence puzzle with heterogeneous step types (shelf-tap, choices, number entry, suspect elimination) that gradually classify a set of jugs
milk-jug-lock.best_for: Detective mysteries with mixed evidence, longer investigation beats

morse-lock.description: Single tap button — short press = dot, long press = dash; auto letter-gap detection; auto-encodes target word to morse

npc-dialog.description: Chat-style NPC with portrait, greeting, and clickable dialog options; supports state-aware lines gated by held cards
npc-dialog.best_for: Story exposition, hint delivery, gated conversations

offering-table-lock.description: Tap items from a shuffled grid onto a central table; correct items stay, wrong items bounce back with per-item flavour text; collect all correct to solve

path-lock.description: Node-edge diagram; tap nodes in the correct order to trace a route through the network

pillar-lock.description: Statements appear one by one; tap the correct Well-Architected pillar (or any category set) it belongs to
pillar-lock.best_for: Categorization drills, framework teaching (WAF, OWASP, etc.)

pipe-lock.description: Grid of rotatable pipe segments; tap tiles to rotate 90°; must connect source to sink with a valid flow path

policy-lock.description: IAM-style JSON policy template with underscored blanks; fill each blank from provided options

prompt-lock.description: Tap fragments to assemble an LLM prompt; combinations map to gold/silver/bronze/fail tiers with different responses

push-luck-lock.description: Draw from a weighted bag — each draw increases multiplier AND bust chance; escalating security scene (CCTVs → guards → dogs → spotlights) visualizes risk; bank or bust
push-luck-lock.best_for: Heist/tension beats, high-agency risk decisions, replayable stakes

query-lock.description: Build a DynamoDB-style query by choosing partition key, sort-key condition, and filter from dropdowns

rank-lock.description: Drag capability badges onto slots on a knight silhouette; rank title upgrades visually (Soldier → Champion) as correct badges are placed; supports decoy badges

rotation-lock.description: Circular dials with evenly spaced symbols; drag each to align target symbol under the marker; optional per-dial lock feedback

scroll-lock.description: Parchment-styled decree with clause blanks; pick a phrase per blank; choices in one blank can disable options in others (constraint propagation)
scroll-lock.best_for: Policy/decree authoring with dependencies, medieval/legal themes

sequence-lock.description: 3×3 grid Simon-says — 'flash' mode plays the pattern, 'blind' mode requires the player to know it from story clues

sg-lock.description: Security group rule table — for each row toggle Allow/Deny; all rows must match the correct policy

slider-lock.description: Stack of horizontal sliders; each must land on its target value (with optional tolerance)

sort-lock.description: Vertical drag list — reorder items into the correct sequence; distractors can be included and are ignored on validation

spec-lock.description: Three-phase-per-round golem interaction: 'vibe' (pick vague prompt), 'chaos' (watch it fail cycling wrong outputs), 'spec' (fill structured spec correctly). Multi-round

spelling-lock.description: Scrabble-board style — a shuffled letter pool per target word; tap letters in order to spell the word; undo/clear

stock-memory-lock.description: Memorize a checklist during a countdown, then grab items from a shelf from memory; some items are spoilt/decoys; optional review-list button with time cost
stock-memory-lock.best_for: Memory pressure with recovery mechanics, inventory themes

streak-lock.description: Rapid-fire multiple-choice with per-question timer; correct answers build a streak multiplier, one wrong or timeout resets it; reach target score

tag-lock.description: Drag key-value tag chips onto resource slots; each resource requires a specific tag set

task-lock.description: Drag containers into a task definition; total CPU/memory must fit limits; correct container set required

terminal-lock.description: Simulated CLI prompt; player types the correct command; wrong attempts show randomized false outputs

timeline-lock.description: Drag incident events into chronological order on a horizontal timeline (sort variant)

trap-disarm-lock.description: KTaNE-inspired — visible wires with color/label/position, manual with partly-redacted conditional rules; deduce the exact cut order; three-strike fail state

waf-lock.description: Live-scrolling request feed; build filter rules (match field + value + action) so that malicious requests get blocked and legitimate pass

wager-lock.description: Metacognitive quiz — before seeing full options, pick a confidence stake (Safe/Confident/All-In) which sets reward, penalty, and number of visible choices; hit target score
supports: custom stakes with per-tier option counts

wire-lock.description: Two columns of terminals; drag or click-click wires to sockets; power-on tests all; decoys allowed

witness-lock.description: For each shuffled witness testimony, select which moment/event it describes from a dropdown

word-lock.description: Rolling letter-reel per word position; scroll each reel so the top row spells the target word
word-lock.best_for: Word-answer gates from clues, combination-lock feel with letters
